The Story

Systems thinkingis a competitiveadvantage.

For three years I've been building at the intersection of AI and marketing — designing systems that most people don't believe are possible until they see them running. From prompt engineering to full-stack AI marketing operations for record labels, the through-line never changed: find the hard problem everyone handles manually, build the system that automates it, and out-execute the doubt.

  • 01

    Automate before it's obvious

    The best opportunities in AI look like over-engineering right up until they look inevitable. I build the system while others are still doing it by hand.

  • 02

    Design systems, not tasks

    I don't solve problems once — I build infrastructure that solves them forever. Every workflow I create is repeatable, scalable, and self-documenting.

  • 03

    Distribution is the product

    Genius unshipped is a hobby. Every campaign and tool I build is engineered around how it reaches the people it was built for.

  • 04

    Combine creativity with data

    Marketing instinct guided by analytics. I think in campaigns and act with metrics — every single day.
